summary: Pin is on a private depot road by the quarry entrance and maintenance depot.
reasons: Mapped private road at the pin
Working depot and quarry entrance, no room
No verge or bay clear of the lane

drivers.seclusion: Wooded, but it is a working depot and quarry entrance with staff and trucks.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed depot road with a gate-like entrance beside the pin. A van would block the lane; no pull-off seen.
drivers.traffic: Depot and quarry vehicles use it; roundabout and gardens road just north.
drivers.convention: Only staff vehicles parked, in the depot yard to the south-east.

flags: Mapped access=private on the way at the pin
Maintenance depot 32 m away, quarry yard to the west
Slope 9% mean, 34% max at the pin
sun_shade: Tree canopy on the east and north sides; open to the west afternoon sun.
